I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low levels of economy, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of ease of service to victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Article 27

(1) The Regency Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, balance and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, activities, Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by Regional Apparatus and PPT.

(3) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine developments and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for Protection of Women and Children.

(4) Monitoring is conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of Regional Apparatus that implement policies, activities for Protection of Women and Children.

(5) Monitoring stages as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. planning

b. policy implementation:

c. program implementation; and

d. Protection of Women and Children activities every year.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by :

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and honor and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to work and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and naturally both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions normally.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

CHAPTER II

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low levels of economy, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.

For the empowerment of victims of violence, the regency government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe House, Child Social Protection House (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection House (RPTC), Women's Social Protection House (RPSW), Shelter House, etc.

The Regency Government is obligated and responsible to implement efforts to protect women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children, establishing PPT, ensuring the implementation of ease of service to victims, seeking effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and seeking the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by :

1. Regency is Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of the regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.

3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the regency region.

5. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.

6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.

7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and honor and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of a person's freedom unlawfully.

9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the territory of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.

10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.

11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and honor and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.

14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to work and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.

15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and naturally both in the family and in society.

16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions normally.

17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional territory to their region of origin.

18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT that organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

What is meant by "physical violence" is an act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death. Letter b

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person. Letter c

What is meant by "sexual violence" is an act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual intercourse and/or forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes. Letter d

What is meant by "neglect" is an act that results in the failure to meet the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, carried out by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care; the act of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be carried out by parents, guardians, or other parties responsible for their care; the act of neglecting a person within the scope of their household, even though according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide life, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or an act that results in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person. Letter e

What is meant by "exploitation" is an act that exploits economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others; an act with or without the consent of the victim including prostitution, forced labor or service, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits; and/or any form of utilization of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all prostitution or indecency activities. Letter f

What is meant by "other violence" is the threat of violence including: any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and coercion, including: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.
